about: Turning Waterloo, Canada into heaven for makers everywhere.

posts.text: Congrats to Jackie Yi, a Waterloo fellow!

We didn’t achieve the results we wanted in the Waterloo mayor elections yesterday. I joined this race because I wanted to tell Waterloo’s stories and share them with people around the world. When I first came to Waterloo, my impression is that this is a city of ambitious tech people, which it is. But during the elections I learned about the dreams of everyone else too, and they’re all very big. Microsoft just offered voluntary buyouts to 60,000 of its employees. This will affect Waterloo greatly. Not only has Microsoft hired more than 2,600 UWaterloo students and alumni alone (as of 2023), this is also a bellwether indicator on employment prospects for those working in Big Tech, and the tech industry as a whole. ~12% of our city is employed in the tech industry. It’s ELECTION DAY in Waterloo, Canada!! If you’re: 1. Canadian citizen 2. 18+ 3. study at UWaterloo or Laurier You’re most likely eligible to vote. Check your eligibility at canivote.ca!

Proud to have earned the endorsement of Waterloo Region Labour Council (WRLC) for Mayor of Waterloo! The WRLC represents 33 unions and ~26,000 workers in Waterloo Region, in both public and private sectors. The election for the next Waterloo mayor is happening tomorrow (Monday) - if you see this, please go out and vote!

I'm running for Mayor of Waterloo, because this city deserves a leader who understands Waterloo's place in Canada, and the opportunities available to be seized. Voting takes place on Monday, Oct 26 - make sure to come vote! If you're a Waterloo, Laurier, or Conestoga student, you are likely eligible to vote in Waterloo! Go to canivote.ca - an app that I built myself to check if you're eligible.

Hello world, Waterloo is organizing a Physical AI hackathon! Jackie Yi, a Waterloo Mechatronics engineer, is organizing a How to Train Your Robot hackathon for the highly curious and talented researchers, builders, and engineers. Theyre looking for both cash and in-kind sponsorships, taking place in 2027, February 5-7.
